note: Machine-readable, fail-closed PRODUCT BOUNDARY — the externally-determined legal state of what this build is permitted to do, as recommended by the 2026-07-19 deep electoral-law review. It is DECLARATIVE: the runtime enforcement lives in the signed control plane (data/governance/control-plane.json) and in the code itself (candidate scores are party-panel-only by construction). scripts/check-product-boundary.mjs is blocking and FAILS CLOSED: it rejects an expired/undated boundary, an unknown enum, a determination that claims a non-pending status without a two-person sign-off, and — critically — any boundary flag that DISAGREES with the runtime control plane (e.g. printMode=disabled while printing is not actually suspended). As of 2026-07-20 the two-person compliance review (cameron-young + tara-buckley) has signed off all six external determinations, so printing and research are re-enabled (their control-plane suspensions lifted with audited RESTORE records) under the National Digital authoriser model and the consent/minimisation controls. Candidate scores remain party-panel-only. The deploy still runs the historical-demo release profile (other programme controls remain partial); full production mode is a separate decision. Bound into the release manifest (productBoundaryHash) so a deploy is pinned to the exact boundary it shipped under.

printAuthoriser.basis: Who legally authorises the generated printed how-to-vote material (s321D).

disclosureEntity.basis: Period-by-period determination in docs/legal/electoral-expenditure.json and docs/legal/electoral-expenditure-determination.md. Reassess before the 2027-01-01 threshold change.

electoralExpenditure.basis: The machine-readable ledger records each financial or transitional reporting period, the applicable threshold, the cash-cost records, conservative electoral amount and return-required result.

privacyActCoverage.basis: Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) coverage and the necessity/consent basis for collecting sensitive political/demographic data.

aecProvenance.basis: Raw AEC candidate/ballot source retention + reviewer sign-off (control-10).

accessibilityHumanTesting.basis: Human assistive-technology testing (control-26) — automated checks alone do not establish equal access.
